  • Enterprise customer delivery experience

job.title: Account Executive - Brisbane
job.description:
Account Executive | Manufacturing & Engineering Technology

We are partnering with a leading ANZ engineering solutions business undergoing a major sales transformation across the manufacturing sector.

The company provides engineering software, simulation technology, consulting and training solutions to customers across:
  • Manufacturing
  • Mining
  • Industrial
  • Packaging
  • Machinery
  • Production environments

They are seeking a Business Consultant focused on:
  • New logo acquisition
  • Competitor displacement
  • Strategic manufacturing sales
  • Consultative engineering solutions selling

This is not a transactional software sales role.
The business is investing heavily in a challenger-style sales approach focused on understanding engineering workflows, operational problems and commercial outcomes.

The successful candidate will:
  • Build new relationships across manufacturing customers
  • Engage engineering, operational and leadership stakeholders
  • Drive strategic sales conversations
  • Identify workflow and operational improvement opportunities

Ideal backgrounds include:
  • CAD / PLM
  • Engineering software
  • Industrial automation
  • Manufacturing technology
  • Technical industrial sales

Salary:
$110k + Super + $12.5k Car Allowance

job.title: Sage X3 Technical Consultant
job.description:
Sage X3 Technical Consultant / Developer
📍 Melbourne | Fixed Term Contract (12 Months) | Hybrid Role

We’re partnering with a well-established Australian manufacturing and distribution business looking to strengthen their internal ERP capability.

This is a hands-on technical Sage X3 role where you’ll go beyond BAU support and play a key part in developing, enhancing, and integrating their ERP environment.

You’ll work closely with the Group IT Manager and broader business stakeholders to deliver ERP improvements, system integrations, and digital transformation initiatives that directly impact operational performance.

What you’ll be doing
  • Supporting and enhancing a live Sage X3 ERP environment
  • Developing custom functionality using Sage X3 4GL
  • Building and modifying screens, windows, and objects
  • Designing integrations using REST APIs, Web Services, and GraphQL
  • Working with SQL Server for data development, optimisation, and troubleshooting
  • Delivering ERP enhancements across manufacturing, finance, and operations
  • Supporting third-party system integrations and automation initiatives
  • Contributing to digital transformation and continuous improvement projects

What we’re looking for
  • Hands-on Sage X3 development experience (4GL)
  • Experience building Sage X3 screens, windows, and objects
  • Strong SQL Server capability
  • Experience with APIs (REST / Web Services / GraphQL)
  • Functional understanding of Manufacturing, Distribution, Inventory, Finance
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work directly with business stakeholders

Highly regarded
  • Crystal Reports
  • Import/Export templates
  • Workflow automation
  • ERP integrations (third-party systems)
  • Manufacturing or distribution environments

If you're a technical Sage X3 specialist who enjoys combining development, integration and business process improvement, I'd be keen to have a confidential conversation.

Apply now or reach out directly for more information.

job.title: Implementation Consultant
job.description:
Implementation Consultant | Remote New Zealand

We're partnering with a profitable and growing global SaaS company looking to add an Implementation Consultant to their customer-facing team.

This is a fully remote role that can be based anywhere in New Zealand.
The position sits at the intersection of implementation, customer success, onboarding and technical consulting.

You will own customer implementations, help clients configure workflows, manage adoption, provide ongoing guidance and ensure customers realise value from the platform.

What you'll be doing:
• Leading customer onboarding and implementation projects
• Configuring workflows and platform functionality
• Acting as the day-to-day technical contact for customers
• Supporting user adoption and long-term platform success
• Working closely with Customer Success, Product and Sales teams
• Identifying opportunities to improve customer outcomes
• Managing a portfolio of customers through implementation and beyond

Backgrounds we are interested in:
• Implementation Consultant
• Customer Success Manager
• Onboarding Specialist
• Professional Services Consultant
• Technical Support Consultant
• Solutions Consultant
• SaaS Project Coordinator
• Junior Implementation Consultant

Requirements:
• 3+ years experience within a SaaS/software company
• Strong customer-facing communication skills
• Experience working with software implementations, onboarding or customer success
• Comfortable learning new technologies and configuring software platforms
• Organised and detail oriented

Package:
• Approximately NZD $110,000 base
• Bonus structure
• Fully remote working
• Strong career development opportunities

If you're interested in exploring a role where you can combine customer engagement, technical problem solving and implementation consulting, we'd love to speak with you.
